name: @dsh-external/project-nav
description: DSH plugin: anti-drift project governance — bidirectional feature<->file mapping, mainline vector, and a governance-first action ledger. v0.4.0: multi-session concurrency (per-scope leases + queueing) and scope file fingerprints. v0.5.0: architecture-first protocol (anchor gate, repeat-patch gate, nav_adr decision ledger). v0.6.0: convergence — architecture stays the core and everything else is auxiliary: one upsert registration tool (nav_update), reference docs query/register in one tool (nav_docs), no separate patch ledger (a patch IS a done action carrying an anchor), auto-anchor for single-target scopes, and ADRs derived into PROJECT.md. 10 tools.
author: Fishsb (lk)
